meta.orientation: A = first ufcstats name (backtest order); share_a = share of the panel / contest entrants picking A; P(A) inputs: rw = (n_a + 0.5) / (n + 1), mm = clip(share_a, 0.03, 0.97), crowd = mean of the available logits

sources.rw: RotoWire staff / expert picks (rotowire.com/mma/article/...): 3-8 RotoWire MMA writers pick every main-card bout of each UFC pay-per-view; 2016 and 2019-2025 here. robots.txt allows every agent; llms.txt invites LLM use
sources.mm: Money MMA pick'em contest consensus (moneymma.substack.com, free part of each results post): the fighter most contest entrants picked and their share, for the contest's five main-card bouts; Feb 2022-Dec 2025. robots.txt allows every agent

not_used.tapology.com: the brief's primary source; robots.txt disallows the whole site for anthropic-ai, Claude-Web and ClaudeBot, so it was not fetched under any User-Agent (also 403 for another agent on Nov 6, data/predictions/cards_upcoming.json)
not_used.robots.txt names Anthropic agents: mmajunkie.usatoday.com, mmafighting.com, mmamania.com, cagesidepress.com, espn.com, betmma.tips, bleacherreport.com, openml.org /api/ (fighters' predictions set)
not_used.refused or unusable: bloodyelbow.com (403 to our User-Agent), sherdog.com staff pick'em (picks are an image), verdictmma.com (picks load from /api/, disallowed), mmasucka.com (no parseable staff-pick table found)

freeze.rw: JSON-LD datePublished must be at least one calendar day before the event (471 bouts); published on the event day = 'same_day', kept in the file but never fit or scored (5 bouts). Articles are re-saved after the event to strike through losing picks and add records; only cell text is read, and the strike marks agree with the results on 2764 of 2773 pick cells (the picks shown are the picks that were scored)
freeze.mm: the consensus is the share of contest entrants (about 50 per card) picking each fighter; entries lock before the card and the results post (1-9 days after) reports them. Per card: 'lock_verified' = the card's contest post (free part, 2025 on) states a lock on the event day no later than the main card's earliest start for the venue's region (LOCK_BOUND_ET: 3 am ET Shanghai, 10 am ET Abu Dhabi, 4-7 pm ET US Fight Nights, 6-6:30 pm ET US pay-per-views); 'contest_pre_event' = a contest post was published before the card but its rules are paywalled (2022-2024) or stale; 'by_design' = no contest post found (kept on the contest's rules; dropped in the strict sensitivity mm_s / crowd_s); 'lock_after_bound' = dropped. Counts: {"lock_verified": 93, "by_design": 280, "contest_pre_event": 210}. Leak checks in cv.freeze

meta.protocol: fights dated 2026-01-01 or later dropped at parse (480); no 2026 source page fetched; 0 2026 rows written outside the repo
meta.method_round_shares: none: RotoWire cells are fighter names only and Money MMA's free consensus block gives winner shares only (its contest asks for the method, but the method consensus is not published); Tapology publishes them and is off limits (robots.txt). Test 3 is run on what exists: the crowd's winner consensus as an input to the method model S2
